name: spine-advisory-website
description: Spine Advisory website: Angular + Bootstrap 5 frontend, Node.js + Express API, PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.render:build: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
